_doc: Special pieces the designer can use (groups 1-4). foot = [length along x, depth along y, height in plates] in the d=0 orientation. ldraw = LDraw files that draw it (at = offset in LDU, ry = quarter turns about the vertical axis, rx = quarter turns about x, c = colour: 'main' or a colour id). r0 = quarter turns that bring the LDraw drawing into the d=0 orientation; d adds more quarter turns. buy = real parts (BrickLink numbers) with colour and quantity. down = which side is low for slopes at d=0. Slopes at d=0: high side at -x, low side at +x. Inverted slopes at d=0: full width on top, the slanted underside faces +x (the top sticks out over +x). cal = how the rotation (r0) is measured automatically. auto = placed by the brick step itself (tall / corner / texture). use = description for the designer (Gemini places these with op 'piece').
